verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no registrable event-subscription webhooks, such as post-call or conversation-event callbacks that a programmatic consumer can receive. The 'webhook tools' are agent-invoked function calls to third-party APIs during a conversation. That is an adjacent tool-calling feature, not event subscription, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
